panels.burned_in_description: Small monitor or scanner overlay text fragments in the corners and bottom margins; too small to read, so whether direct identifiers are present is undetermined.
panels.notes: Bone-surface 3D rendering of skull and cervical spine photographed from a display; no soft-tissue face. Only the orientation letters PR and AR were readable; other overlay text is not legible.

face: Both show a three-dimensional bone-surface rendering of the skull, upper teeth, orbit and cervical vertebrae from an oblique side direction, the left image with the face directed to the right and the right image with the face directed to the left.
In each image a long chain-like plate with round screw holes runs from the region behind the lower face down and around beneath the upper teeth, forming a loop under the maxilla;

panels.face_description: Lower half of the face (nose, upper lip, cheek) is visible; the eyes are outside the frame.
panels.notes: Intraoperative photograph with drapes and instruments; no printed text. Open wound and oral cavity are visible; no genital anatomy.

face: The visible face is the lower half only: nostrils, upper lip with a black suture crossing the midline, and a cheek with stubble.
Below and to the right, the lower face is opened into a wide raw wound with red muscle, pale fibrous and bony-looking surfaces and bleeding edges;
Open surgical field over the lower face with drapes, a gloved hand, a suture across the upper lip, an exposed tongue and instruments.

panels.face_description: Lower face (nose, lips, chin) is visible with the eyes covered by gauze.
panels.notes: Frontal clinical photograph with no printed text; no genital anatomy.

face: Color photograph of a face from the front and slightly below.

panels.notes: Photograph of a harvested flap on a blue drape; no face, no printed text, no sensitive anatomy.
